festivals.what: Aomori Nebuta Festival, Aomori City: held every year 2 to 7 August (night parades 2 to 6 August; daytime parade, fireworks and sea parade on 7 August). Paid reserved seats from ¥2,600; other viewing free.

laws.rule: Hirosaki City accommodation tax: JPY 200 a person a night (about A$1.80, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) at hotels, ryokan, simple lodgings and minpaku in the city, collected by the lodging. School trips and nursery or kindergarten events (with their supervisors) are exempt. The Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications consented on 22 July 2025, with the ordinance set to take effect on 1 December 2025.
